**Reasoning:**
This presentation is highly characteristic of **Powdery Mildew** — white powdery colonies of fungal conidia (Leveillula taurica or Oidium neolycopersici) developing on the leaf surface. The key distinguishing features are:
- White powdery/silky growth on the upper leaf surface
- No necrotic lesions or spots typical of Early Blight or Septoria
- No dark spots or concentric rings of Early Blight
- No water-soaked lesions of Late Blight
- No mosaic/mottling pattern of viral diseases
